name: Stim
description: Stim is a high-performance stabilizer circuit simulator optimized for quantum error correction research, developed by Google Quantum AI. It uses 256-bit AVX vectorized instructions and can analyze a distance-100 surface code circuit with 20,000 qubits in under 15 seconds.

sources.title: Stim: a fast stabilizer circuit simulator

news.title: Stim 1.16.0 Released
news.excerpt: Latest release of Stim, a fast library for analyzing quantum stabilizer circuits.
